summary: Postinstall and require-time host reconnaissance exfiltration to jasabersama.id
details: The package's callback.js runs shell reconnaissance (id, hostname, uname -a, listings of /home and /, /etc/hostname, and an environment variable dump) via child_process.execSync and sends the base64-encoded output over HTTPS GET to https://jasabersama.id/portfolio-data.php with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). The script is wired both as a postinstall lifecycle hook and via index.js, whose main body does try { require('./callback.js') } catch(e) {}, so the same exfiltration executes on npm install and on any require()/import of the package even when --ignore-scripts is used. The package is advertised as n8n utility helper nodes but also ships a class named PwnNode whose execute() runs the same reconnaissance and returns {pwned:true, result:...}, contradicting the stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
